title: Registration Criteria for Measurement Businesses (related to Article 12 (1))
full_text:
■ Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters [Attached Table 1] <Amended 2018.12.11>

Registration Criteria for Measurement Businesses (related to Article 12 (1))

| Category | Registration criteria |
|---|---|
| Personnel requirements | All of the following personnel requirements must be met. |
| Personnel, item 1 | Employ construction engineers falling within each of the following items, from among the construction engineers under Attached Table 1 to the Enforcement Decree of the Construction Technology Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as “construction engineers”). |
| 1 (a) | At least one construction engineer at each of the junior, intermediate, and senior grades whose professional field is civil engineering. |
| 1 (b) | At least one intermediate-grade construction engineer whose professional field is electricity and electronics. |
| Personnel, item 2 | The engineers under item 1 must, after recognition of their relevant technical qualifications, have completed the practical education and training course conducted by the Minister of the Interior and Safety pursuant to Article 30 of the Act. |
| Equipment held | Hold all of the following equipment: 1. Inclinometer measuring equipment; 2. Groundwater-level measuring equipment; 3. Pore-water-pressure measuring equipment; 4. Rainfall measuring equipment; 5. Ground-surface-displacement measuring equipment; 6. Extensometer measuring equipment; 7. Surveying equipment capable of three-dimensional coordinate surveying. |

Notes:
1. For the construction engineers required under each subitem of item 1 in the personnel requirements column, a construction engineer of a higher grade may replace a construction engineer of a lower grade.
2. Where at least one information and communications engineer of intermediate grade or higher is employed from among the technical-category information and communications engineers under item 1 of Attached Table 6 to the Enforcement Decree of the Information and Communications Construction Business Act, the technical personnel requirement under item 1 (b) in the personnel requirements column is deemed to be met.
